profile: Xenetic Biosciences is a biopharmaceutical company developing immuno-oncology technologies for difficult-to-treat cancers. Its proprietary DNase technology is designed to target neutrophil extracellular traps, which can contribute to cancer growth, metastasis, and resistance to treatment. The company is advancing a systemic DNase program toward clinical study in people with locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors, initially focusing on pancreatic, colorectal, and other gastrointestinal cancers.
